⚠️ The Business Challenge

In the CPQ project, during the migration from the Encompass platform to our in-house tool, product specifications had to be validated across systems.

  • ✅ Large volume of products and data
  • ✅ Multiple technical specifications
  • ✅ Manual comparisons
  • ✅ Time-consuming data validation
  • ✅ Risk of human error
